snippet.title: I Hosted The Food World Cup
snippet.description:
#ad Join Revolut and get £20 ($20 USD for customers based in the US) by clicking here: https://get.revolut.com/z4lF/johnnellis
━━━━━━━━━━━━
I donated £920 to Mary’s Meals - which feeds 48 children for a year. 

Donate yourself here 👇
https://donate.marysmeals.org/gb
━━━━━━━━━━━━
I hosted the first ever World Cup of Food with @CelineDept! 

Every country at the 2026 World Cup has a chance to win… but this time, it’s not about football. It’s about food. 

Celine and I tried foods from every single nation competing at the 2026 World Cup, including national dishes, snacks, drinks, desserts and some very questionable surprises. 

We started with the group stage, where each country had to fight for a place in the knockouts. From there, the best foods went head-to-head to decide which country officially wins the World Cup of Food.
